title: .objection.json
description: Opts a repository in to objection: the rules its debates follow. Read from the base branch, never from the branch under review. In a monorepo, <dir>/.objection.json adds rules for the files under <dir>/ (verify, invariants, reviewers and strongPaths only; paths relative to <dir>, commands run from it).

bases.description: Every branch a PR may target. A record is valid only against the base it was debated on.

defaultBase.description: The base to debate against by default. One of bases.

verify.description: Cheap proof (types, tests) that must pass before any reviewer runs, as the base branch defines it.

budget.description: How many reviewers and rounds a debate runs. lean when absent.

invariants.description: Rules that must never break, each with the paths it guards. A violation is a BLOCKER.

paths.description: A regex matched against changed paths.

verify.description: A command debate.sh runs from the repository root when the diff touches paths; a failure is a BLOCKER.

reviewers.description: Extra accusers under standard and thorough, when the diff touches paths.

agent.description: opus, sonnet, haiku or claude-* run on that model; gemini, gemini-<model> and codex run through that CLI; anything else is a label.

paths.description: A regex matched against changed paths.

strong.description: Used when an invariant or strongPaths matches, or under thorough (opus).

strongEffort.description: The strong tier's effort, apart from effort.

laterEffort.description: The accuser's effort in later rounds, which review only the fix (low).

strongPaths.description: A regex of paths that deserve the strong model (a gate, a validator, billing).

smallDiff.description: Under lean, a diff of at most this many changed lines that no invariant or strongPaths touches runs no reviewer (20; 0 turns it off).

maxRounds.description: Rounds a branch may have before debate.sh refuses another (2 under lean, 3 otherwise). A further one needs --extra-round, when the human asks.

enforce.description: false for advisory mode: the local hook reports what it would block and lets it through.
